aoi.local_crs: local tangent metres, x=east, z=north, y=elevation metres

disclosure.aoi: AOI is an OSM-derived pilot bbox and not an official Gia Loc ward boundary.
disclosure.buildings: Microsoft building heights are unavailable in this AOI; displayed heights are deterministic area-class proxies.
disclosure.canopy: ETH canopy values are modeled raster samples, not individual-tree inventory.
disclosure.sentinel: Sentinel-2 TCI is 10 m public satellite visual data, not 1 cm orthophoto.
disclosure.temporal: Sentinel temporal heatmap is candidate spectral difference only and not a violation or new-building detector.
disclosure.terrain: COPDEM is a public 30 m-class context DEM; not survey DTM/DSM or LiDAR.
disclosure.water: JRC water history is remote-sensing evidence, not drainage, flood-depth, or hydraulic modelling.
